faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 1 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Spooky listener tales featuring hidden squatters, cursed campfires and cemetery shadows.
kurzfassung: In this special Halloween episode, the hosts read listener-submitted spooky stories involving strange encounters. Listeners share chilling experiences ranging from a babysitter confronting an intruder with a Bop It to a creepy camping trip in the Catskills. The episode also features hospital hauntings and a shadowy entity near an old cemetery.
stichpunkte: A babysitter in 2008 fights off a neighbor's adult son who was squatting in a shed by hitting him with a Bop It.
A camping trip in the Catskills leads to a forgotten village, a Ouija board session, and an unsettling dream about a colonial woman.
A nurse experiences strange heart monitor activity after the death of an elderly patient, followed by mysteriously falling wall decor.
Two high schoolers encounter a towering shadow figure with glowing red eyes in a century-old cemetery.
The hosts read stories submitted by listeners while dressed in bloody Halloween costumes and wigs.

clips.hook: Defending against an intruder with a Bop It
clips.text: The teenager realizes she has backed into a toy during the home invasion and instinctively decides to use it as an improvised weapon against the attacker.

clips.hook: Finding human teeth scattered in the woods
clips.text: A group of campers discovers hundreds of teeth on the ground in an abandoned forest area, which they confirm to be human by comparing them to a separate stash of raccoon teeth.

clips.hook: A sudden temperature drop and a Ouija board warning
clips.text: During a nighttime Ouija board session in the woods, the surrounding air temperature drops drastically and the game board is violently knocked off its stone base.

clips.hook: A hospital heart monitor answering questions like a seance
clips.text: A priest uses a disconnected hospital heart monitor to communicate with a deceased patient by asking yes-or-no questions answered through automated beeps.

clips.hook: A towering shadow creature rising in a graveyard
clips.text: Two teenagers in an old cemetery spot a crouching black mass that suddenly stands up into a massive, Slenderman-like shadow figure.

Weirdos! It's almost HalloWEEEEEEEEN! So grab your pillowcase, don your spookiest costume, and get ready to be treated to some iconic listener tales! To celebrate the most wonderful time of the year, Deb has curated a batch of spooky tales that are BY you FOR you and ALL ABOUT YOU! Don't forget to check out the YOUTUBE version to fully experience the iconic costumes, because Ash & Alaina are serving this month!
If you’ve got a listener tale please send it to Deb by emailing us at Morbidpodcast@gmail.com with “Listener Tales” somewhere in the subject line, and if you share pictures, please let us know if we can share them with fellow weirdos! :)
